rationale: Create one canonical Intersect Power record for the Google-owned digital-power and data-center platform that remained after the March 10, 2026 transaction close. Google acquired the Intersect team, digital-power business and included co-located projects; excluded grid-tied operating and development assets became the separate IPX Power platform. Preserve CAI, Greenbelt/Trilantic, TPG Rise Climate and Pantheon/PINT as former Intersect owners. Pantheon's post-close exposure is to IPX, not Intersect, and no later Intersect ownership transfer was identified.

afterImage.description: Intersect Power is a U.S. digital-power infrastructure platform that develops co-located land, data-center shells, solar generation, battery storage and hybrid firming solutions for hyperscale cloud, AI and other energy-intensive customers. Google acquired the company on March 10, 2026 for US$4.75 billion, after making a minority investment in December 2024. The acquired company includes the Intersect team, digital-power business and specified co-located projects. Separate grid-tied operating and development assets were carved out into IPX Power and are not part of this PortCo. Former Intersect investors included Climate Adaptive Infrastructure, Greenbelt/Trilantic, TPG Rise Climate and Pantheon Infrastructure. Intersect reports a historical track record exceeding US$20 billion and 11.5 GW across 14 facilities, including legacy assets now assigned to IPX. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
